snippet.title: Rogue Carrier Announcement Trailer | Roguelite Colony Management Game
snippet.description:
Manage a colony and explore an alien world aboard a massive ocean-faring ship in Rogue Carrier. Stranded on an unknown planet, you must seek essential resources to power vital production chains, manage crew morale and needs as you build your mobile colony, and defend yourself against all manner of existential threats in your quest for answers.

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714000/Rogue_Carrier/
